description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Ezreal''' fires a powerful arc of energy in the target direction that briefly grants [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of its surroundings and deals magic damage to enemies hit.
description.text: Active: Ezreal fires a powerful arc of energy in the target direction that briefly grants sight of its surroundings and deals magic damage to enemies hit.

description2.raw: [[File:Minion icon.png|20px|link=Minion|An icon representing the keyword Minion]] [[:Minion|Minions]] and non-epic [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]] take modified damage.
description2.text: Minions and non-epic monsters take modified damage.

leveling.raw:
'''Magic Damage:'''
350 / 450 / 550 / 650 / 750 (+ 100% '''bonus''' AD) (+ 110% AP)

leveling2.raw:

notes.raw:
* ''Trueshot Barrage's'' projectile has an [[File:Trueshot Barrage Minimap.png|40px|link=]] icon on the mini-map while it is in flight. It can be seen by only '''Ezreal''' and his allies.
* This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the start of the cast time.
